_doc: Where a level stands its weapons of the arena (scripts/stash.gd), where the spot that scripts/arena.gd works out (Arena.hideouts()) is not a good one: {"<level>": {"specials": {"<weapon>": [x, y, z]}}}, the weapon by the name of its file in weapons/. A weapon a level does not name here gets the spot that is worked out; a level that is another played otherwise says {"like": "<level>"} and has its spots. Each spot here was looked at in the game: see PLAN.md, 'Wapens afgebouwd'.
